name: Ebed-melech
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org

cases.name: Ebed-melech the Ethiopian
cases.charge: Going out to the king in the gate of Benjamin and telling him the princes had done evil to Jeremiah, then drawing the prophet up out of the dungeon of mire with old cast clouts and rotten rags under his armholes
cases.preview: When the princes had Jeremiah let down into the miry dungeon to die, Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, a eunuch of the king’s house, went to Zedekiah at the gate of Benjamin, told him the princes had done…
